headline: Centur-Ion Deck
title: Centur-Ion Deck Guide | Best Yu-Gi-Oh Duel Links Decks November 2026
video_script: This is the Centur-Ion deck in Yu-Gi-Oh Duel Links, a Tier 1 deck on Duel Links Meta this week. The Skill is The Courage to Rise. During your turn you can only summon Centur-Ion monsters from the hand or Deck. Once per Duel, reveal a Centur-Ion monster to add any Centur-Ion card from your Deck. And once per Duel, add an Emblema card and place a Centur-Ion monster in your Spell and Trap Zone. The key cards: Centur-Ion Primera is a Tuner that adds any Centur-Ion card from your Deck when it is summoned. Centur-Ion Trudea puts itself and another Centur-Ion monster in the Spell and Trap Zone as Continuous Traps, and from there they jump back out during the Main Phase. The Field Spell Stand Up Centur-Ion! lets you Synchro Summon right after a monster is Special Summoned, even on your opponent's turn. Emblema Oath places another Centur-Ion monster from your Deck as a Continuous Trap. And the boss, Centur-Ion Legatia, a Level twelve Synchro with three thousand five hundred attack that draws a card and destroys your opponent's strongest monster when it is Special Summoned. How does it play? Its monsters wait in the Spell and Trap Zone, then come out on either player's turn and Synchro Summon into Legatia. Effect Veiler, Droll and Lock Bird and Nibiru stop the opponent. This list is a King of Games Cup top 100 list from the eighteenth of November, with 30 cards in the Main Deck. Which deck should I cover next? Comment below!
